summary: Fixes project creation finding no candidates for non-arXiv or Chinese topics (半导体生长, 古典文学发展史). Creation used OpenAlex.discover(): arXiv-only, title-only with every word required, from 2024, Chinese text sent unchanged. New OpenAlex.discover_topic (title+abstract, any source, relevance order for creation or newest-first for refresh, relevance top-up, Chinese straight to relevance), query sanitising, per-project refresh from project keywords, seed picker ranked by title match with Unicode-aware de-duplication, cache TTL with stale fallback, rate-limit note shown in Settings, shorter pauses with an API key, and one added sentence in the guidance prompt asking for English plus Chinese search phrases. ADR 0012.
scope_note: On top of e384cbf. Narrow OpenAlex-adapter fix on this branch; the full multi-discipline design is on worktree-channels (ADR 0010) and will conflict at merge in app/sources.py and app/service.py. The owner's .claude files are excluded locally.

budget_impact.rationale: The project_guidance prompt gains one sentence (estimated 40-60 tokens, unmeasured, inside the registered instructions component of 350; caps unchanged, scripts/budget.py --check passes). No new operation and no ceiling raised. OpenAlex requests: up to two per creation query, up to three keywords per project refresh; the allowance is shown in Settings.

quantified.period: per project_guidance turn (registered reference turn; the after figure adds the estimated upper 60 tokens, unmeasured)

budget_impact.before: project_guidance system instruction without a language rule for search_queries; daily refresh always searched 'world model'.
budget_impact.after: One extra sentence (about 40-60 tokens, estimate); refresh searches the project's own keywords. Caps unchanged.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: PaperDigHelper.app rebuilt; creation page not exercised in the window

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; adapter, refresh and prompt only
One separate read-only code-review agent (same model family, not a human); its five findings were fixed afterwards and the fixes were not re-read by a reviewer.

open_risks: NEW OUTBOUND DATA to confirm: every project refresh now sends up to three project keywords (including pinned profile terms) to OpenAlex; before it sent only 'world model'.
The prompt sentence has not been tried with a real DeepSeek call; the model may not return English and Chinese queries as asked. Its token cost is an estimate.
Chinese-language coverage in OpenAlex is old and uneven; a Chinese-only project may get no new papers in the daily feed until a Chinese source is available.
Papers topped up in relevance mode are stored without match_mode, so the daily feed cannot label weak matches.
Merging worktree-channels will conflict with this change (app/sources.py, app/service.py); both sides moved to title_and_abstract.search.
Not exercised: the creation page in the app window, and a real AI-guided session.
